# agents-toc

Keep a one-line lazy-load index inside your `AGENTS.md` in sync.

```text
your project
├── AGENTS.md            ← edited freely; only the INDEX block is managed
├── skills/
│   ├── wt/SKILL.md
│   └── guardrails/SKILL.md
└── knowledge/
    ├── git.md
    └── testing.md
```

After `agents-toc sync`, the fenced block inside `AGENTS.md` becomes:

```markdown
<!-- INDEX:START -->
<!-- Generated by agents-toc v0.1.0. Do not hand-edit. Run `agents-toc sync` to refresh. -->

### skill/

- `skills/guardrails/SKILL.md` — git hook layer
- `skills/wt/SKILL.md` — worktree manager

### knowledge/

- `knowledge/git.md` — git workflow patterns
- `knowledge/testing.md` — vitest patterns

<!-- INDEX:END -->
```

The agent now knows every skill and knowledge file *exists* — without paying
the token cost of loading their bodies until they're actually needed.

## Install

```sh
# Homebrew
brew install noamsiegel/tap/agents-toc

# Go
go install github.com/noamsiegel/agents-toc@latest

# Curl
curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/noamsiegel/agents-toc/main/install.sh | sh
```

## Quickstart

```sh
cd your-project
agents-toc init                       # scaffold .agentsmdrc.yaml
agents-toc sync                       # write the INDEX block into AGENTS.md
agents-toc install-hook               # auto-regen on every commit
```

That's it. `sync` is idempotent — run it as many times as you like.

## What it does

- **Scans** any sources you configure: `skills/**/SKILL.md`, `knowledge/**/*.md`,
  anything with YAML frontmatter and a `name` + `description` (or `id` + `summary`).
- **Renders** a one-line entry per file: `path — summary`. Customize the template.
- **Splices** that rendered block between `<!-- INDEX:START -->` and
  `<!-- INDEX:END -->` markers inside `AGENTS.md`. Bytes outside the markers
  are never touched.
- **Validates** frontmatter — required fields, duplicate names — and exits
  non-zero if any file is missing what its source declared required.
- **Installs hooks** into your existing manager (lefthook > husky > raw
  `.git/hooks`), so `sync` runs on every commit and re-stages the file.

## What it doesn't do

- It is not a skill marketplace, registry, or package manager.
- It does not ship any skill or knowledge content of its own.
- It does not serve skills at runtime (see `skills-mcp` for that).
- It does not mirror to `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, or `GEMINI.md`.
  `AGENTS.md` is already the cross-vendor convention; symlink the others if
  you need them.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `agents-toc init` | Scaffold `.agentsmdrc.yaml`. |
| `agents-toc sync` | Regenerate the INDEX block (idempotent). |
| `agents-toc sync --check` | Exit non-zero if the index is stale; CI gate. |
| `agents-toc validate` | Check frontmatter; exit non-zero on issues. |
| `agents-toc list [--json]` | Print everything that would be indexed. |
| `agents-toc install-hook` | Wire pre-commit (auto-detects lefthook/husky/raw). |
| `agents-toc version` | Print version, commit, build date. |

## Config

`.agentsmdrc.yaml` (defaults shown; only override what you need):

```yaml
version: 1

sources:
  - glob: "skills/**/SKILL.md"
    label: "skill"
    frontmatter:
      name_field: "name"
      summary_field: "description"
      respect_disabled: true

  - glob: "knowledge/**/*.md"
    label: "knowledge"
    frontmatter:
      name_field: "id"
      summary_field: "summary"
      require: [id, summary]
      respect_disabled: true

target:
  file: AGENTS.md
  marker_start: "<!-- INDEX:START -->"
  marker_end:   "<!-- INDEX:END -->"
  create_if_missing: true

render:
  group_by: label              # or "none" for a flat list
  sort: alphabetical           # or "mtime"
  line_template: "- `{path}` — {summary}"
  group_template: "### {label}/\n\n{lines}\n"
  empty_message: "_no entries_"

ignore:
  - "**/node_modules/**"
  - "**/.git/**"
  - "**/vendor/**"
```

See [`docs/CONFIG.md`](docs/CONFIG.md) for every field and how it interacts
with the rest of the pipeline.

## How it compares
## Dogfooding

This repo runs `agents-toc` on itself. The `<!-- INDEX:START -->` block in
`AGENTS.md` is regenerated by CI; `agents-toc sync --check` fails the build
if the committed AGENTS.md drifts from the docs/ directory.

## How it compares

| Tool | Verb | What it writes | When it runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| **agents-toc** | index | a managed block inside your AGENTS.md | commit-time + on-demand |
| `agents-md` | compose | the whole AGENTS.md from fragments | commit-time |
| `skills-mcp` | serve | nothing on disk; serves skills via MCP | runtime |
| `agent-rules-skill` | onboard | a fresh AGENTS.md from repo metadata | one-shot |
| `anthropics/skills` | spec | nothing — defines the SKILL.md format | n/a |

`agents-toc` is the narrowest of the bunch. It does **one thing**: maintain a
fenced index block. It composes cleanly with the others — `agents-md` can
own the prose around the block, `skills-mcp` can serve the same skills at
runtime, `anthropics/skills` defines the on-disk format we consume.

More detail in [`docs/COMPARISON.md`](docs/COMPARISON.md).

## Hooks

`agents-toc install-hook` detects your hook manager and wires a pre-commit
entry that runs `agents-toc sync && git add AGENTS.md`. Idempotent — re-run
freely.

| Manager | Detection | Where it writes |
|---|---|---|
| lefthook | `lefthook.yml` or `lefthook.yaml` | `pre-commit.commands.agents-toc-sync` |
| husky | `.husky/` directory | `.husky/pre-commit` (managed block) |
| raw | fallback when `.git/` exists | `.git/hooks/pre-commit` (managed block) |

Pass `--manager <name>` to force one. Pass `--force` to refresh an existing
entry.

See [`docs/HOOKS.md`](docs/HOOKS.md).
